messages.text:
The wider pass found three concrete issues: `--only-files` should filter a directory’s children rather than treating the directory argument as a file row, missing paths should return status 2, and a couple of directory labels need to preserve the reference’s Windows path spelling more carefully.

I’m patching those now.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); & $ref probe_dir/sub -T --color never --icons never; & $ref rust-reference/tests/itest -T -L 0 --color never --icons never; & $ref rust-reference'"\\tests\\itest -T -L 0 --color never --icons never"
